Review result: no blockers. Safety-floor work (lead room, the post gate); this PR fixes P3 issue #2677, so one collaborator review is enough for the merge rule.

What we checked. We merged the head into current main in a review worktree; the merge is clean. We built and tested that tree, debug: `camcraft-motion` lib 447 pass, 0 fail; the six `contour*` motion binaries green (6+2+21+8+6+2); `camcraft-app` `contour_whole_step` 8 pass and `contour_start_point` 3 pass; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. The author's own quick gate (124 steps, 0 failed) matches our result.

Law check. The fence only makes the lead room tighter; the verifier's `Crossing` law does not change. A case the fence misses still gives a visible block, never a silent wrong path. This is the right direction for the Prime Directive. `per_ring.get(k)` with an empty default errs toward no fence, which keeps the same visible-block property. The `Some(None)` conviction in the section slice still runs before the wall filter (#2680 law, untouched). Every error path that carries the partial path calls `flush_planned!` before it returns; error paths that do not carry the path do not need the bands. The move order in the builder is the same as before: each band still emits in plan order.

Notes, not blockers. The fence is per band, not per level; a lead can shorten at a fenced ring on a level no other band shares. The decision file records this; it is conservative. Lead notes of a band now come after the planning notes of later bands; the decision file records this too, and the pinning tests hold. A later flush error can now surface before a later band's plan error; the band that fails first is the one that stops the run either way.

Pinning: `leads_of_one_outline_do_not_cross_a_grown_outline_on_the_same_level` (red before, green after; asserts empty `depth_verify` warnings with no stock and with stock top 31) and the two `case1 ... 18.5` app cases (post not blocked, pass at Top Z 15, no pass at Z 13.5).

Verdict: ready to merge when flagged ready. Label set to merge-ready.

Merge class: SAME. The head is `7e5e646b23d3c7a50fbee47edadb810439f10080`, the head that the review of 07:56 UTC names (comment 7003224243). No commit came after that review. The PR merges cleanly with `main`. This merge relies on that review. The PR fixes a P3 issue, so one collaborator review is sufficient.
